'''Joseph Peter''' (born 23 September 1949) is a Swiss [[long-distance track event|long-distance runner]]. He competed in the [[Athletics at the 1980 Summer Olympics – Men's marathon|marathon]] at the [[1980 Summer Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/pe/joseph-peter-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418122435/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/pe/joseph-peter-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 April 2020 |title=Joseph Peter Olympic Results |accessdate=13 May 2017}}</ref>
